classification_result.error_message: This document is an order confirmation (Bestellbestätigung) without payment proof
classification_result.reasoning: This document is clearly an order confirmation from Amazon.de, not an expense receipt. It shows an order that has been placed but not yet shipped or paid for. There is no evidence of payment completed, just order details.

schema_field_analysis.expense_identification_reasoning: Despite having 7 of the 8 schema fields, this is NOT an expense document because it lacks proof of payment. This is clearly a 'Bestellbestätigung' (order confirmation) showing what will be shipped and billed, not what has already been paid. Per the criteria, booking confirmations without payment proof are not expenses.

validation_result.compliance_summary: This expense fails compliance validation due to five critical issues: 1) Incorrect customer name (shows employee instead of company name), 2) Incorrect customer address (shows employee address instead of company address), 3) Missing customer VAT number, 4) Invalid receipt type (order confirmation instead of tax invoice), and 5) Missing expense description. All issues must be resolved before approval. The primary concern is that this appears to be a personal purchase rather than a company expense since the employee's personal details are used instead of the company's information.
